create_transformer_model: create a JAX LLAMA2-like Transformer model with configurable sharding and conditional inputs
build_rotary_embeddings: build rotary positional embeddings using precompute_freqs_cis and apply_rotary_emb for attention layers
configure_model_args: configure a ModelArgs dataclass with dimensions, layers, heads, dropout, and MLP type settings
run_attention_forward_pass: run grouped multiquery attention with causal masking, RoPE embeddings, and optional dropout
test_feedforward_mlp: test the FeedForward module with swiglu, geglu, or glu activation and configurable hidden dimensions
